parse_ebnf_grammar: parse an EBNF grammar file into a structured grammar encoding for recognition
create_string_recognizer: create a StringRecognizer from a parsed grammar to validate CalFlow expressions
test_accept_string: test whether a CalFlow expression is fully accepted by the grammar
test_accept_prefix: test whether a CalFlow expression is a valid prefix of the grammar
review_calflow_test_cases: review the CalFlowTestCase dataclass and valid and invalid sentence test data
